course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Collections: order, named fields and lookup by key
goal: Choose an Array, Structure or Map for its purpose and calculate a total while distinguishing order, fields and keys.

prerequisites.text: The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.

sections.title: An array preserves a sequence
paragraphs: Our requests now take different durations: 30 and 45 minutes. Массив preserves a sequence. Добавить appends an element; the first index is 0, so МинутыЗаявок[0] is 30. There are two elements and the last valid index is 1.

Для Каждого visits the values in turn. The accumulator starts outside the loop: after 30 it is 30, after 45 it is 75. Reordering these numeric inputs changes traversal order but not their sum. An invalid index is an error, not a request for an imaginary zero.

sections.title: Trace the main example
paragraphs: The array supplies inputs, the loop totals 75, the structure names the result and the map retrieves it by a training key.

sections.title: A structure names the fields of one record
paragraphs: Карточка has Клиент and Минуты fields. Карточка.Минуты communicates meaning more clearly than an arbitrary index. Structure field names must be suitable property identifiers. Several unrelated fields do not become a sequence of requests merely by being placed together.

The duration field receives the computed 75. This is an in-memory structure; creating it does not write a catalog item or database document. For an optional field, use Свойство("FieldName", Value) rather than assuming a misspelling returns an empty string.

sections.title: A map associates a key with a value
paragraphs: Соответствие is useful for lookup by key rather than position or a predefined field name. "Клиент-А" is an educational label here. A changeable customer name is not reliable identity in a real application; later lessons introduce catalog references. Inserting the same key replaces its associated value rather than appending a second array row.

Получить on a missing key returns Неопределено, which differs from a stored numeric zero. Do not add an unknown value to a duration without deciding what absence means. It might indicate that the total has not been calculated. Check the expected value and its type first.

sections.title: A missing value or a stored zero?
paragraphs: Absence and a known zero total are different states.

code.output: The first key stores zero; the second returns Неопределено.

sections.title: Two variables can name the same mutable object
paragraphs: ВтороеИмя = МинутыЗаявок does not create an independent array. Both variables access the same mutable object; an append through one is visible through the other. Build a new array and transfer values for an independent flat collection. Nested mutable objects need an additional copying decision.

A preservation check compares actual contents before and after, not just variable names. An empty array leaves this accumulator at zero under our chosen rule. A text value among numeric durations needs a different response: detect and reject it rather than trusting its numeric appearance.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Two elements do not make index 2 valid. For two elements use indexes 0 and 1; handle an empty array before indexing.
An in-memory structure does not write database records. Persisting data needs an explicit object operation; a structure only stores in-memory values.
Reusing a map key replaces its value; it is not a new request. Use a distinct key for a distinct entity and check the previous total was not replaced accidentally.

selfcheck.prompt: What is the first array index?
What does Получить return for a missing key?
selfcheck.feedback: A missing value differs from a stored zero.

selfcheck.prompt: Does assigning an array to another variable create an independent collection?
options: No, it is the same mutable object
Yes, if the name is new
selfcheck.feedback: A variable name does not define an object copy.

selfcheck.prompt: In a separate copy alias the array and append through the alias; then explicitly create an independent flat array and repeat.
selfcheck.feedback: Shared identity and a new collection are distinguished; the original working source remains available.

steps.expected: The intended module is open and the earlier source remains available.
steps.troubleshooting: If you cannot identify the infobase, return to the startup list and check its entry and directory.

steps.where: The same module, then Enterprise mode and Nexus notes
